rationale: The assistant correctly identified normal cooling-fan run-on and recommended no action or part, matching the ground truth. Weaknesses: it asked no diagnostic questions in turn one (e.g. does it stop by itself, longer after grill), and the odd unplug-reset test ('if the noise stops immediately after that reset') is confusing and not useful. It also gave no warranty fallback if the fan ran constantly when cold, though overall the outcome is safe and sensible for the homeowner.
rationale_note: Minor overconfidence in 'standard design on most modern Samsung combi microwaves' and 'probably' hedging was adequate.
